summary: Orla Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 1, 2026, reporting an illegal work stoppage and blockade by unionized workers at its Camino Rojo mine in Mexico. Operations are temporarily halted; safety and environmental monitoring continue. The dispute involves a worker productivity bonus and profit-sharing (PTU) calculation. The Company has paid the maximum legal profit-sharing and is negotiating with union leadership. A meeting with federal labor conciliation is scheduled for June 2. The Company will assess impacts on full-year production guidance. This is an operational disruption, not a special situation.
